author: Inside Edition
description: In 2023, Zachariah Swope became a Guinness World Records holder for the most films seen in a cinema in one year. And now he wants to beat his own record. Last time, Zach watched 777 movies in a year. This time around, he's aiming to watch 850 to 900 movies. The rules, which are the same, are very strict. Not only is Zachariah doing this because he loves movies, but he's also raising awareness for mental health. Inside Edition Digital has more.
title: Movie Lover Is Attempting To Break Guinness World Record Twice
